stem:
Multiple choice question: During a school garden activity, Meera and her classmates are asked to group the plants and animals they see. Which of the following is a correct way of grouping them ( )
A. Grouping a rose and a hibiscus together because both have red flowers only, and ignoring all other features
B. Grouping a cow, a goat, and a hen together because all are animals that give useful products to people
C. Grouping a mango tree and a cat together because both are tall
D. Grouping a fish and a bird together because both can move fast

options.text: Grouping a rose and a hibiscus together because both have red flowers only, and ignoring all other features
Grouping a cow, a goat, and a hen together because all are animals that give useful products to people
Grouping a mango tree and a cat together because both are tall
Grouping a fish and a bird together because both can move fast

teacher.key_rationale: B uses a valid, shared observable feature (animals giving useful products) as the basis for grouping. A relies on a single superficial feature while ignoring differences, C mixes a plant and an animal on an incorrect feature, and D uses speed, which does not capture meaningful similarities between fish and birds.
